tagline: Save YouTube videos by URL, keep their transcripts in a local library, and generate structured AI summaries of them.
summary: Innertube is a personal YouTube transcript library. Paste a video URL and the API fetches the transcript through YouTube's InnerTube endpoints (no YouTube API key) and saves the video and transcript in local Postgres. From a video's page you can refetch the transcript or click **Generate summary** to get a structured summary from Claude.

Every summary run is recorded as a request / exchange / response ledger with tokens and estimated cost, and the summary prompt is versioned in the database. The UI always shows the latest completed summary.
audience: You learn from long YouTube videos (talks, podcasts, tutorials) and want searchable transcripts and summaries.
You want to keep the library on your own machine.
You have an Anthropic API key for summaries.
notFor: Downloading video or audio — transcripts only.
Videos without captions — there's nothing for InnerTube to return.
Chatting with a transcript — the old transcript chat was removed (`drop_video_transcript_chat.sql`).

capabilities.title: Add by URL
capabilities.detail: `POST /api/data/videos/from-url` fetches the transcript and saves the video.

capabilities.title: Video library
capabilities.detail: `/videos` lists saved videos; `/dashboard` is the app home.

capabilities.title: Video detail
capabilities.detail: `/video-detail-page` shows the transcript, **Refetch transcript** and **Generate summary**.

capabilities.title: AI summaries
capabilities.detail: Structured summaries from Claude (`claude-sonnet-4-6` by default); transcripts are trimmed to 120,000 characters.

capabilities.title: Prompts and costs
capabilities.detail: `/ai-prompts` shows the versioned summary prompts (read-only); `/ai-costs` lists exchanges with estimated USD.

capabilities.title: Transcript-only endpoint
capabilities.detail: `POST /api/transcript` returns a transcript without saving anything.

components.name: Web app
components.owns: Landing, `/learn`, dashboard, videos, video detail, AI prompts and costs. Calls the API at `NEXT_PUBLIC_INNERTUBE_EXPRESS_URL`.

components.name: API
components.owns: InnerTube transcript fetching, the `innertube` Postgres schema (`videos`, summary ledger, prompts, `llm_models` cost rates), summary generation.

dataFlow: You paste a YouTube URL in the web app.
The API calls YouTube's InnerTube endpoints to get caption tracks and the transcript.
The video and transcript are saved to `videos` in local Postgres.
**Generate summary** sends the (trimmed) transcript and the current prompt to Anthropic and stores the request, exchange and response rows.

trust.title: API (your machine)
trust.detail: Holds `DATABASE_URL` and `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`. No auth on routes.

trust.title: YouTube / Anthropic
trust.detail: YouTube sees transcript requests from your IP; Anthropic receives transcripts you summarize.

commonTasks.title: First-time setup
steps: On the **API Express** repo, **Set up local database** (or `createdb innertube && psql "$DATABASE_URL" -f migrations/setup.sql`).
Set `DATABASE_URL` and `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` in the API's Environment step.

commonTasks.title: Save and summarize a video
commonTasks.when: You want to keep a video's content.
steps: Paste the URL on `/videos` (or the dashboard).
Open the video and click **Generate summary**.

commonTasks.title: Upgrade an older database
steps: If the database had transcript chat tables, run `drop_video_transcript_chat.sql`, then `setup.sql`.

troubleshooting.fix: The video may have no captions, be private or age-restricted, or YouTube changed InnerTube. Try `POST /api/transcript` to see the raw error.
`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` missing, or the model name in `TRANSCRIPT_SUMMARY_MODEL` is invalid.

troubleshooting.symptom: Summary cut off on very long videos

glossary.definition: YouTube's internal API used by its own clients; used here to read caption tracks.
Table of AI exchange tables with cost rates, used for `/ai-costs`.
The versioned system prompt for transcript summaries (`summary_ai_flow_prompt`).

hubNotes: The registry's `expectedTables` only lists `videos`; the full schema also has the summary ledger, prompt and registry tables.
Web README is partly still the template, but the API README is current and accurate.
